title: Consolidate cross-SDK retry taxonomy and streaming idempotency guidance
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create a single cross-SDK guidance document that specifies default retry/backoff policies, a clear error taxonomy (retryable, idempotent-retryable, non-retryable, retry-after-required), and idempotency key semantics extended to streaming and resumable streams. Deliverables include language-idiomatic examples for Python/TypeScript/Go, small reference implementations for client-side token generation and server handling, and a short migration guide for existing customers.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Publish a canonical cross-SDK spec in the SDK repo that defines defaults: attempts=5, base_backoff=100ms, max_backoff=10s, jitter=full/random, use-exponential; 2) Document mapping of HTTP (429, 5xx, 408), transport (connection reset, timeouts), and application-level errors to retryability categories and recommended action; 3) Define idempotency semantics for request/response endpoints and streaming endpoints (chunk-level replay, resumable offsets, token lifetime, server-supplied server-ack semantics); 4) Implement defaults in Python/TS/Go SDKs with feature flags allowing overrides; 5) Add unit + integration tests and perf verification showing no regression on p50/p95 for streaming under default settings; 6) Publish migration notes and examples (code snippets) in the public docs.
updates: 2025-02-12: Kickoff meeting with SDK leads (Asha, Daniel, Lin). Agreed scope: taxonomy + streaming idempotency + SDK defaults. Action: draft spec.
2025-02-14: Initial spec draft uploaded to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1SDK-Retry-Idempotency-Draft. Asked for feedback from Go/TS/Python leads.
2025-02-16: Offline review from Maria Gomez (runtime) - suggested adding guidance for KV cache mismatches and model-variant fallbacks being non-idempotent. Added to taxonomy.

2025-02-18: Prototype of client-side idempotency token (UUID v4 + request fingerprint) pushed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/2143. Tests added for resume semantics in streaming client.
2025-02-20: Design review scheduled for 2025-02-22. Need alignment on default attempts and jitter strategy across languages; TS team prefers smaller base_backoff for browser contexts.
Open: follow-ups include: (a) decide browser vs server defaults for TS; (b) add E2E test harness for simulated network flakiness; (c) update Console docs with new retry metrics tags.
